OUR IMPACT

## We transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and
## health.

[ Our Purpose ][124]
* [
  Mobility
  [An aerial view of a highway with moving traffic.]
  We play a fundamental role in advancing the future of mobility on the road, in the air and in
  orbit—from critical materials that power battery systems, to safety components like airbag
  initiators, and more.
  ][125]
* [
  Energy
  [Aerial night view of a bustling city with illuminated skyscrapers, roads, and a few cars,
  showcasing a vibrant urban landscape.]
  We support the build-out of energy storage systems that help power data centers and ensure a more
  reliable grid.
  ][126]
* [
  Connectivity
  [A view of earth from space at night showing the planet's curved horizon. Some clouds are
  illuminated by city lights. Clusters of city lights showing in certain areas looking like
  connected light streams.]
  We enhance safety and reliability in connections, from fire safety compounds in electronics, wires
  and cables to the protective glass on phones.
  ][127]
* [
  Health
  [Grocery store produce isle]
  We produce specialty chemicals and additives for medicines, disinfectants and solutions that keep
  our food and water safe and plentiful.
  ][128]
ALBEMARLE BY THE NUMBERS


## A Global Footprint, Built for Reliable Supply

[Photo of green trees for Albemarle Sustainability 2024]

SUSTAINABILITY

## A Sustainable Future

We’re committed to sustainability in all that we do, transparently sharing insights into our
sustainability strategy, objectives and accomplishments. Our approach to environmental stewardship,
responsible sourcing, community engagement and employee welfare is a daily pursuit across all
aspects of our organization.

Our innovative technologies and practices minimize our environmental footprint and ensure a
sustainable supply of critical minerals for the future while minimizing our environmental impact
today.

[ Direct Lithium Extraction ][129] [ Sustainability at the Salar Plant ][130] [ Albemarle 2025
Sustainability Report ][131]
[A female scientist in a lab coat conducts an experiment in an industrial setting, interacting with
equipment while examining a sample in a mixing dish.]

## Let's Build a More Resilient World Together

Albemarle attracts people who want to do well by doing good. As a leader in our industries we invite
you to explore our career opportunities worldwide. 

[ View Careers ][132]
All the elements for a better world.

# Creating a world of opportunities

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Growing from a small business in the Midwest to one of the largest privately held companies in the
world, Koch’s story is one of transformation: guided by principles, built for the long term and
focused on creating opportunities that help improve lives.  

[Get to know Koch][100]

What we do

## Everyday essentials. Transformative innovations.

Koch acquires, creates, develops and invests in a diverse group of companies, spanning from paper
goods to software and much more in between.

# Creating a world of opportunities

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Growing from a small business in the Midwest to one of the largest privately held companies in the
world, Koch’s story is one of transformation: guided by principles, built for the long term and
focused on creating opportunities that help improve lives.  

[Get to know Koch][100]

What we do

## Everyday essentials. Transformative innovations.

Koch acquires, creates, develops and invests in a diverse group of companies, spanning from paper
goods to software and much more in between.

[See what our companies make][101]

Latest Happenings

][104] [ [a couple of men sitting in chairs]
Principle-Driven Leader

### Companies

][105]

Join us

## Put your potential to work

Find a role that matches your strengths at a company that helps you grow. With opportunities across
industries, Koch supports careers as unique as the people building them. 

[Discover opportunities][106]
[a woman wearing gloves and standing in a factory]

how we’re different

## Principled thinking. Real results.

Principle Based Management™ and stewardship guide everything we do — from how we empower employees
to how we innovate, solve problems and contribute to society.   

[See what sets us apart][107]

  Petrochemicals Company
  We focus on eco-friendly materials to lead the sustainability business.
* **Advanced Materials [**Advanced Materials][156]
  Advanced Materials Company
  We aim to become a global top‑tier battery and electronic materials company leading
  next‑generation technologies.
* **Life Sciences [**Life Sciences][157]
  Life Sciences Company
  We aim to rise as a global pharmaceutical company that develops innovative new drugs.

Petrochemicals Company
We focus on eco-friendly materials to lead the sustainability business.
The Petrochemicals Company is LG Chem's major business area with world-class productivity and cost
competitiveness. We have established a vertically integrated system from basic raw materials such as
ethylene and propylene to downstream products such as PE, ABS, and synthetic rubber.
Advanced Materials Company
We aim to become a global top‑tier battery and electronic materials company leading next‑generation
technologies.
The Advanced Materials Company is enhancing our business competitiveness in specialty materials
through a market and customer-oriented approach.
Life Sciences Company
We aim to rise as a global pharmaceutical company that develops innovative new drugs.
As a new growth engine for the future to be fostered in the medium and long term, the Company has
differentiated R&D capabilities that have received new drug approval from the U.S. FDA for the first
time in Korea.

# Home

We are a global advanced materials and recycling group. We reduce harmful emissions, power the
vehicles and technologies of today and tomorrow, and give new life to used metals.

[Discover Umicore][81]
Our markets & solutions

## From our lab to your home, and everywhere in between

[Automotive & Mobility][82]
[Energy][83]
[Electronics & Telecom][84]
[Recycling Solutions][85]

## Roadmap to 2028

Umicore's path forward to 2028 is grounded in our strengths and built on our solid foundations.

[Discover more][87]

## We are the circular materials technology company

With a closed-loop business model and leading innovation, we develop materials that transform
everyday life and improve the planet’s health. Through our expertise in material science, chemistry
and metallurgy, we meet the growing demand for metal-based technologies, recycling, cleaner
mobility, and advanced materials for energy, electronics and more. 

[About Umicore][88]

# Home

We are a global advanced materials and recycling group. We reduce harmful emissions, power the

## We are the circular materials technology company

With a closed-loop business model and leading innovation, we develop materials that transform

mobility, and advanced materials for energy, electronics and more.

## Plasma Technology

## Plasma Technology

## Transforming Legacy Industrial Production with High Efficiency Plasma Technology

##### Replace outdated dirty process technologies with clean, efficient production
* Highly engineered products
* 2 second production vs 2 day
* 50%-90% lower cost
* Scalable, small production footprint
* Infinite performance material options

[Learn More][37]
[Advanced Materials Production]
[6k inc Forest Background]

## The World’s only Sustainable Production for Advanced Materials

##### Clean technology is clean… isn’t it?

The global demand for lithium-ion battery cells is forecast to increase from approximately 700
gigawatt-hours in 2022 to 4,700 gigawatt-hours in 2030.


6K Energy’s domestic CAM production can deliver battery material to help fill the demand while
producing material in a much more sustainable way.

Reduce 70% of CO2 GHG = 40 billion pounds
[6k inc Frog Silhouette on Leaf]
Reduce 70% of CO2 GHG = 40 billion pounds
Reduce 100% of wastewater = 203 billion liters
[6k inc Reduce Water Waste]
Reduce 100% of wastewater = 203 billion liters
Reduce 90% of water use = 188 billion liters
[6k inc Water Bottle]
Reduce 90% of water use = 188 billion liters
Reduce 70% of energy use = 26 billion kWh
[6k inc Plug and Socket Icon]
Reduce 70% of energy use = 26 billion kWh
[production for lithium-ion batteries]

## Pioneer Today, Enable Tomorrow: 6k Brings Infinite Material Possibilities

##### Meeting the world’s future needs for materials: UniMelt microwave plasma breaks the rules
* Previously unattainable design flexibility
* From nanometers to microns: 10,000 x size
* Metals, alloys, oxides, silicon, carbides, nitrides & more
* Hollow, dense, nano-foam, single crystal, transparent, meta-stable, intermetallic composite & more

[Learn More][38]
[Advanced Additive manufacturing Infographic]
[scrap material AM powder feedstock]

## Their Scrap is Our Feedstock: Creating A Circular Economy

##### Paving the way for domestic performance material manufacturing independence
* Access to infinite supplies of scrap metals, used batteries and powders
* Local and on shore production from domestic feedstock
* Address national security of critical materials
* Reduce mining of scarce minerals
* Support local circular economy ecosystems

[Learn More][39]
[6K inc Cargo Ship]
6K reduces dependence on foreign materials and ensures supply chain integrity by unlocking domestic
supplies of feedstock
[Light Bridge 6k inc]

## How Does it work?

##### UniMelt Plasma is proven high volume production system for performance materials
* Digital process control
* 6,000 degree operations (6K)
* 99% efficiency (microwave to plasma)
* Under 2 second production time
* 99.999% contamination free

[Learn More][40]
[UniMelt® Plasma Technology Process]

Aqua Metals is the only company to have demonstrated a commercially proven, sustainable, closed-loop
metals recycling process capable of producing some of the world’s highest-purity battery materials.

Our Innovation Center is advancing low-carbon metals recycling technologies designed to reduce
environmental impact, deliver competitive economics, and improve worker safety.

force behind the next generation of battery materials refining.

## Lithium Ion: Powering the New Energy Era

Aqua Metals applies its water-based AquaRefining™ technology to lithium-ion batteries and battery
materials – advancing a low-carbon recycling and refining approach designed to support
commercial-scale operations.


The process is engineered to produce high-purity battery metals with competitive operating
economics, while avoiding the furnaces, high temperatures, and emissions associated with
conventional smelting and refining.

# BASF Battery Materials · A leading global supplier of cathode active materials

## Shaping the future of electromobility

## We are a leading global supplier of advanced Cathode Active Materials (CAM) for the lithium-ion
## batteries market, providing high-performance CAM to the world’s largest cell producers and for
## leading OEM platforms.


We complement our portfolio with Sourcing & Metals Management, as well as various Battery Recycling
solutions.

By leveraging our industry-leading R&D platforms and passion for innovation, we develop unique,
proprietary solutions that drive customer success.
 

[Learn more about us][1]

## Our Solutions

Cathode Active Materials
We offer one of the broadest Cathode Active Materials (CAM) portfolios in the industry and optimize
our solutions for all application segments.
1. [Read more][2]
Battery Recycling
We are your reliable solution provider along the entire battery recycling value chain.
1. [Read more][3]

# The Green Super­material of the Future

Utilizing CO₂ to build a climate positive industry.

## We turn something bad into something good

Our cutting edge technology transforms harmful, excessive greenhouse gas into clean, valuable carbon
products.

## Why ChooseClean Carbon

Carbon capture, storage and utilization (CCSU) are the only group of technologies that reduce and
remove CO₂ emissions from the atmosphere.

Powered by Norwegian green energy, our innovative technology transforms CO₂ molecules into carbon
and oxygen.

We then use carbon atoms to build different carbon structures, such as graphite, hard carbon and
carbon nanotubes.

Combining green energy and CO₂ as raw material results in products with an extremely low CO₂
footprint.
* Carbon capture, storage and utilization (CCSU) are the only group of technologies that reduce and
  remove CO₂ emissions from the atmosphere.
* Powered by Norwegian green energy, our innovative technology transforms CO₂ molecules into carbon
  and oxygen.
* We then use carbon atoms to build different carbon structures, such as graphite, hard carbon and
  carbon nanotubes.
* Combining green energy and CO₂ as raw material results in products with an extremely low CO₂
  footprint.

Our current focus

## Green productionof materials for thebattery industry

Battery material demand is expected to **increase by 300% by 2025**. By shifting from fossil to
green carbon production, CO₂ emissions would be significantly reduced.

[electric bike]
[battery]

## Other application areas

The use of green carbon has a significant positive environmental impact on virtually any product. We
are continuously working on the development of new application areas, including those listed below.
* ### Electronics
  
  Carbon-based materials are an alternative to silicon technology and have proven to be very
  effective to fabricate electronic devices with superior performance.
* ### Energy
  
  Utilizing green carbon in clean technologies not only reduces carbon emissions but also fosters
  sustainable development, paving the way for a greener and more resilient energy sector.
* ### Aerospace and defense
  
  Currently, weight and material are some the most significant hurdles in space equipment. Our green
  carbon material could make many of today’s products lighter and stronger, such as spacecrafts,
  space suits and space stations.
* ### Automotive
  
  By utilizing green carbon in battery production and employing it to make vehicle structures
  lighter and stronger, we not only promote sustainable mobility but also contribute to the
  development of a cleaner and greener transportation system.
* ### Sports
  
  From eco-friendly sporting equipment to sustainable stadiums, using green carbon promotes
  environmental responsibility, creating a greener and more sustainable sports industry.
* ### Construction
  
  By incorporating green carbon materials into construction materials such as concrete, steel, or
  aluminum, we enhance their mechanical properties, making them stronger and more durable.

### Cerus Corporation is dedicated solely to safeguarding the world’s blood supply and aims to
### become the preeminent global blood products company.

Headquartered in Concord, California, the company develops and supplies vital technologies and
pathogen-protected blood components to blood centers, hospitals, and ultimately patients who rely on
safe blood.

The INTERCEPT Blood System for platelets and plasma is available globally and remains the only
pathogen reduction system with both CE mark and FDA approval for these two blood components.

In the U.S., the INTERCEPT Blood System for Cryoprecipitation is approved for the production of
Pathogen Reduced Cryoprecipitated Fibrinogen Complex (commonly referred to as INTERCEPT Fibrinogen
Complex), a therapeutic product for the treatment and control of bleeding, including massive
hemorrhage, associated with fibrinogen deficiency. The INTERCEPT red blood cell system is under
regulatory review in Europe, and in late-stage clinical development in the U.S.

About Cerus

##### About Cerus

Cerus Corporation is dedicated solely to safeguarding the world’s blood supply and aims to become
the preeminent global blood products company. Headquartered in Concord, California, the company
develops and supplies vital technologies and pathogen-protected blood components to blood centers,
hospitals, and ultimately patients who rely on safe blood. The INTERCEPT Blood System for platelets
and plasma is available globally and remains the only pathogen reduction system with both CE mark
and FDA approval for these two blood components. In the US, the INTERCEPT Blood System for
Cryoprecipitation is approved for the production of Pathogen Reduced Cryoprecipitated Fibrinogen
Complex (commonly referred to as INTERCEPT Fibrinogen Complex), a therapeutic product for the
treatment and control of bleeding, including massive hemorrhage, associated with fibrinogen
deficiency. The INTERCEPT red blood cell system is in late-stage clinical development.  For more
information about Cerus, visit [www.cerus.com][93] and follow us on [LinkedIn][94].

About Cerus

##### About Cerus

Cerus Corporation is dedicated solely to safeguarding the world’s blood supply and aims to become
the preeminent global blood products company. Headquartered in Concord, California, the company
develops and supplies vital technologies and pathogen-protected blood components to blood centers,
hospitals, and ultimately patients who rely on safe blood. The INTERCEPT Blood System for platelets
and plasma is available globally and remains the only pathogen reduction system with both CE mark
and FDA approval for these two blood components. In the US, the INTERCEPT Blood System for
Cryoprecipitation is approved for the production of Pathogen Reduced Cryoprecipitated Fibrinogen
Complex (commonly referred to as INTERCEPT Fibrinogen Complex), a therapeutic product for the
treatment and control of bleeding, including massive hemorrhage, associated with fibrinogen
deficiency. The INTERCEPT red blood cell system is in late-stage clinical development.  For more
information about Cerus, visit [www.cerus.com][93] and follow us on [LinkedIn][94].

## **Elinor Launches Technology partnership**

Elinor Batteries plans for a giga-scale battery factory near Trondheim, Norway. Based on 100%
renewable energy and nordic mineral resources, the factory will supply sustainably produced
batteries to the European Energy Storage market. Now, Elinor announces its partnership with the very
highly regarded team behind Morlus Technology, some of the most experienced battery design and
production experts globally.

[ Read the article ][34]

## Why should Norway produce batteries?

According to international experts, Norway has everything it takes to become a global leader in the
battery industry. No other new, green industry can create as much welfare. The setting is quite
similar to how Norway built global leadership from scratch in the oil business.

# FULLy integrated, autonomous & chemistry agnostic Materials Acceleration Platform for sustainable
# batteries

FULL-MAP is a revolutionary project aimed at accelerating the research, design, development and
processing of next-generation batteries by utilizing AI-powered platforms, high-throughput testing,
and autonomous synthesis techniques.

[full map hero home]

## What is
## FULL-MAP?

FULL-MAP is a pioneering initiative that redefines battery innovation by creating a Materials
Acceleration Platform (MAP) for faster, more efficient development of ultra-high-performance
chemistries. It integrates inverse material design, computational methods, AI, Big Data, autonomous
synthesis, and high-throughput testing. This modular approach simulates the entire process from
material to cell assembly, incorporating environmental and economic factors to advance sustainable
battery technology.

[Learn more][12]

## Data & Code Gateway

### [The FULL-MAP GitHub Gateway][13]

Tools, workflows, code scripts, collaborative environment for modelling

[yancy min 842ofhc6mai unsplash]

### [The FULL-MAP data repository][14]

Access metadata, arrays, and shared datasets, caddy formats

[luke chesser jkutrj4vk00 unsplash]

## Latest news

### [Laminography for Battery Research: Seeing More in Flat Electrodes][15]

General Information

Understanding battery materials requires seeing beyond what is visible from the outside. This
article explores how advanced X-ray laminography is helping researchers reveal hidden structures
inside flat battery electrodes, unlocking new insights that could contribute to safer, more
efficient, and longer-lasting batteries.

[image1]

### [Bridging the data gap: How Transfer Learning accelerates the shift to new battery materials and
### chemistries][16]

General Information

What if new battery technologies didn't have to start from scratch? In FULL-MAP, Transfer Learning
allows researchers to reuse knowledge from data-rich battery chemistries to accelerate the
development of safer, cheaper, and more sustainable alternatives, reducing both time and testing
requirements.

[unnamed]

### [Unlocking AI potential in battery research: the role of BattINFO][17]

General Information

How can AI unlock the full potential of battery research? BattINFO transforms fragmented data into
structured knowledge, enabling smarter discovery and faster innovation.

[image1]
[More news][18]

# Building A Secure Battery Supply Chain with Proven Graphite & Anode Processing Technology

[ Discover Our Advantage ][50]

## Breakthrough Technology Meets Proven Scale

Global Battery Materials combines a **prior-producing**** Canadian graphite mine** with **validated
South Korean anode processing expertise**. We’re a fully integrated company that delivers natural
graphite and premium anode materials through patented technologies, mature pilot operations, and
capital-efficient production methods. 

**Because the world cannot wait. **While others build from scratch, we scale existing infrastructure
and proven technology to meet surging demand faster and more cost-effectively. 

## Experienced Leadership with a Track Record of Proven Execution

Our leadership team combines deep mining, battery technology, and M&A execution expertise. With a
track record of building and scaling projects globally, Global Battery Materials is uniquely
positioned to deliver critical minerals and battery materials quickly and efficiently. 

[ Meet Our Leadership Team ][51]

## World-class graphite and AAM. Secure supply.

Vertically integrated from mine to market, Global Battery Materials delivers graphite critical
minerals and premium active anode material (AAM) vital to modern technology, defence, and energy
infrastructure.

## Kearney Mine Restart in Canada

## Q4 2027

## Kearney Mine Graphite Resources (total indicated and inferred)

## 63 million tonnes

## AAM Pilot Production and R&D Facility in Korea and North American Expansion

## up to 100,000 tpa

## Taking Urgent Action to Secure Critical Mineral Supply

Graphite is irreplaceable. Growing energy and electrification needs, from EVs to AI datacenters and
defence applications, are constrained by import dependence on critical minerals at a time of record
demand. Lithium-ion batteries require more graphite than any other mineral, including lithium,
cobalt, or nickel. As the dominant active anode material across all lithium-ion battery chemistries,
graphite demand is surging across all electrification sectors. Today’s supply remains dangerously
concentrated, creating an urgent need for reliable, stable, and experienced alternatives.

Graphite is irreplaceable. Growing energy and electrification needs, from EVs to AI datacenters and
defence applications, are constrained by import dependence on critical minerals at a time of record
demand. Lithium-ion batteries require more graphite than any other mineral, including lithium,
cobalt, or nickel. As the dominant active anode material across all lithium-ion battery chemistries,
graphite demand is surging across all electrification sectors. Today’s supply remains dangerously
concentrated, creating an urgent need for reliable, stable, and experienced alternatives.

# What is IREC
# all about?
* Public research centre focused on advancing sustainable energy.
* Creating scientific knowledge with real technological impact.
* Driving the energy transition through research and innovation.
* Working with partners to advance the future of clean energy.

[Multidisciplinary research and innovation ecosystem focused on sustainable energy]

## Discover IREC

Learn who we are and how our research drives innovation in sustainable energy.

[See more][165]

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

[Entrance of IREC in Barcelona, the headquarters of the Catalonia Institute for Energy Research, a
centre focused on renewable energy research, innovation, and the energy transition.]
[Discover our departments][166]
[Foto del equipo de IREC en el Institut de Recerca en Energia de Catalunya (Barcelona), mostrando
investigadores y profesionales que impulsan la innovación en energías renovables, tecnologías
limpias y soluciones sostenibles alineadas con los retos energéticos globales y la competitividad
industrial.]

## Meet our team

Discover the people behind our science, innovation and sustainable energy goals.

[Discover our team][167]
[Investigador de IREC sosteniendo un dispositivo energético flexible en un laboratorio,
representando la investigación avanzada en tecnologías de energías renovables, la innovación y
soluciones sostenibles para abordar los retos energéticos globales y mejorar la competitividad
industrial.]

## What we do

We conduct research, development and innovation across the full spectrum of sustainable energy, from
the fundamental properties of new materials to the integration of renewable technologies, from the
decarbonisation of industry to the design of more efficient buildings and communities.

Our work connects scientific knowledge with real-world application, supporting the energy transition
at every scale: from laboratory to field demonstration, and from solutions relevant to Catalonia and
Spain to contributions to the European research agenda.

# When Batteries End,
# We Begin

LICO Materials recycles and repurposes end-of-life lithium-ion batteries to recover critical
materials and give them a second life for a sustainable future.

[ Explore Our Process ][14]

## What We Do

We recycle end-of-life lithium-ion batteries to recover battery materials like lithium, cobalt,
nickel, and manganese, reintegrating them into the battery supply chain to promote a circular
economy. We also repurpose these batteries into energy storage solutions through LiGRID, our
sustainable Battery Energy Storage System.

##### Recycle

Recycling end-of-life lithium-ion batteries

##### Recover

Recovering lithium, cobalt, nickel, and manganese of battery-grade purity

##### Repurpose

Repurposing end-of-life lithium-ion batteries into LiGRID—a sustainable Battery Energy Storage
System

## Our Journey Towards Sustainable Energy

Our journey began with a clear purpose: to create a sustainable circular economy by recycling
end-of-life lithium-ion batteries.

[Gaurav Dolwani]

Recycling isn’t just about recovering materials; it’s about restoring value. We see every
end-of-life battery as the beginning of a new possibility. By repurposing responsibly, we close the
loop between innovation and sustainability. The future is circular and it starts with how we choose
to recycle and repurpose today.

###### Gaurav Dolwani

CEO & Founder
[Workers]

## Sustainable Process in Action

## Our Impact

We have processed batteries equivalent to

### 0

##### Electric Vehicles

### 0 Mn

##### Mobile Phones

By 2027

### 0

##### EVs Annually

Saving **100M litres water**
CO₂ offset = **37M trees**

## Supporting EPR and ESG Compliance

[Card Image]

We work with mobility manufacturers, energy storage companies, battery pack assemblers, e-waste
collectors, aggregators, and the informal sector to manage their end-of-life lithium-ion batteries.
We help them meet EPR requirements and ESG goals through safe collection, tracking, and recycling.
* Safe collection, tracking, and recycling of end-of-life lithium-ion battery
* EPR compliance documentation and Pollution Control Board portal submission
* ESG reporting support — providing quantified data on CO₂ emissions, waste and material recovery

[ Explore More ][15]

## Closing the Battery Lifecycle Loop

We support the circular battery economy by ensuring end-of-life battery is fully utilized through
repurposing cells into energy storage and recovering critical materials by reintegrating in new
batteries.

01

#### Battery Collection

End-of-life lithium-ion batteries are collected at the source, with safe logistics and complete
tracking

#### Dismantling & Testing

Batteries are dismantled and tested for internal resistance, State of health (SOH), and temperature
performance to assess usability

02
03

#### Recovery of Critical Materials

Critical materials such as lithium, cobalt, nickel, and manganese are recovered from end-of-life
lithium-ion batteries through recycling

#### Repurpose Batteries

Batteries with good SOH are repurposed into LiGRID, a sustainable Battery Energy Storage System

04
05

#### Feed Cells Forward

Repurposed end-of-life lithium-ion batteries are incorporated into energy storage systems (LiGRID)
for end-use applications

### Zer Waste · Maximum Recvery
* Industry-high recovery rates
* Zero discharge, no harmful emissions
* Reduced mining dependency
* Supporting India’s EV & clean energy transition

[ Explore More ][16]

## Our Facility

At our state-of-the-art facility in Bengaluru, we recycle and repurpose end-of-life lithium-ion
batteries with a current infeed capacity of 4 GWh. Designed for scalability and efficiency, the
facility uses advanced, safe, and environmentally responsible processes to handle increasing volumes
of battery waste, with plans to expand capacity to 10 GWh by 2027.

## Certifications

Certified, Compliant, Credible

repurposing cells into energy storage and recovering critical materials by reintegrating in new

### THE TECHNOLOGY

## What is metal Additive Manufacturing?

Metal Additive Manufacturing, also known as metal 3D printing, enables the production of complex
parts without many of the constraints of traditional manufacturing processes. 

It is defined as “the process of joining materials to make parts from 3D model data, usually layer
upon layer, as opposed to subtractive manufacturing and formative manufacturing methodologies.”

### THE TECHNOLOGY

## What is metal Additive Manufacturing?

Metal Additive Manufacturing, also known as metal 3D printing, enables the production of complex
parts without many of the constraints of traditional manufacturing processes. 

It is defined as “the process of joining materials to make parts from 3D model data, usually layer
upon layer, as opposed to subtractive manufacturing and formative manufacturing methodologies.”

###### About Us

### Welcome to NEO Battery Materials LTD.

NEO Battery Materials is a Canadian battery materials company focused on developing and
manufacturing silicon-enhanced lithium-ion batteries for drones, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV),
robotics, consumer electronics, AI data centre energy storage, and all battery-powered applications.
With a proprietary, low-cost manufacturing process, NEO Battery enables longer-running and
ultra-fast charging batteries for emerging electronics systems. The Company aims to be a globally
leading end-to-end solutions provider from high-performance battery materials to cells and visions
to construct a resilient North American supply chain.

# Why Northvolt

The world is turning its back on fossil fuels. With the change comes new opportunities and new
demands for industry. Together, let's build a cleaner world.

[Join us][18]

## Partners

[Epiroc]
[Volkswagen]

## Green batteries for a blue planet

We’re in the battery business. Manufacturing with clean energy, our mission is to deliver batteries
with a 90% lower carbon footprint compared to those made using coal energy. And we’re building them
into solutions to make the world a better, cleaner place.

[Our cells][19]
Founded


A diverse, inter-disciplinary team of talent of over 5500, representing over 100 nationalities.

Reduced footprint


%

less CO2 compared to cells made using coal power by 2030.

Capacity


GWh

Northvolt's target for lithium-ion cell installed capacity.

## Calling all problem solvers

**career** Going to work is much more exciting when you can see how your daily efforts have a direct
positive impact on the future. Join us in inventing, manufacturing and recycling the world’s
greenest batteries!

[Join us!][20]

## Powered by the force of nature

**Sustainability** A big contribution to Northvolt’s low-carbon footprint comes from our commitment
to power our factories with clean, renewable energy. Combine that with minimal resource use
alongside battery recycling and you have the blueprint for the world’s greenest battery.

[Read more][21]

## Solutions

### [Automotive][22]

[Automotive]

### [Construction][23]

[Construction]

### [Disruptors][24]

[Disruptors]

### [E-mobility][25]

[E-mobility]

### [Grid][26]

[Grid]

### [Industrial][27]

[Industrial]

## Latest news

30 January, 2025

### [Leadership transition at Northvolt North America: Paolo Cerruti steps aside as CEO and remains
### Chairman of the Board ][28]

29 January, 2025

### [Volvo Cars takes full ownership of NOVO Energy ][29]

20 August, 2024

### [Northvolt to advance lithium-metal battery technology from Northvolt Labs ][30]

## Batteries made from batteries

**Recycling** No battery lives forever. But when they contain recyclable materials, they’re always
valuable. By recovering used batteries and recycling them into raw materials for new batteries,
we’re lowering the demand for fresh material and moving closer to closing the loop on batteries.

[Introducing Revolt][31]

## The Northvolt way

A model defined by technical leadership and rooted in a commitment to sustainability.

[Read more][32]

### Collaboration

Our customers have the products and applications. We welcome you in to work side by side in
developing tailor-made solutions.

### Sustainable by default

Going green isn’t an optional extra at Northvolt. It’s baseline. Ethical sourcing, smart engineering
and a commitment to clean energy behind every cell.

### Fully connected

Battery management software, product traceability, remote access… all delivered through Northvolt’s
software harnessing machine learning.

# Let's Make an Impact

## At SSOE, we’re designing and building the future, today.

And we want you to be a part of it. We’re internationally ranked architects and engineers who thrive
on challenge, embrace innovation, and believe that collaboration is what powers progress. Together,
we can build great things.

[See our services][50] [Join our team][51]

### The firm of choice for clients and employees.

“At SSOE we have the privilege of working with so many cutting-edge, visionary clients who are
positively shaping the world towards a more sustainable future. The way we’re enabling the global
transition to renewable energy is just one of many examples of that. It’s truly exciting to be part
of something so significant and dynamic. More personally, at SSOE you have the freedom to shape your
own career path and explore various directions. You do this while immersed in a company culture that
challenges you to grow all the while encouraging you to live and enjoy a balanced life.”

### Brandon, Southeast Division Manager, Vice President

[Testimonial Image]

“SSOE has more experts in the industry compared to many, or all of the engineering firms here in the
United States. The people I’ve dealt with at SSOE for more than 20 years have always been very
professional and easy to work with. They can communicate with people in the industry and know what
they’re talking about in terms of types of processes and can come up with creative ideas and
solutions.”

### Chief Operating Officer, Battery Manufacturing Client

[Testimonial Image]

“The diverse range of projects I have the privilege to work on at SSOE is always an exciting
challenge. Every day, I get to learn and expand my expertise while collaborating with engineers and
project managers who are equally driven to succeed. Our team manages projects from inception to
completion, allowing me to see the tangible impact of my work. There’s nothing more rewarding than
walking into a grocery store and seeing a product I helped create on the shelf.”

### Gabrielle, Process Engineer

[Testimonial Image]

“SSOE brings enthusiasm and strong project management skills to the table. They are approachable, no
ego, and always provide cutting-edge solutions to our challenges.”

### Design Manager, Semiconductor Manufacturing Client

[Testimonial Image]

## Our Work

From businesses that drive innovation, to institutions that develop the workforce of the future, to
public spaces that bring people together—whatever the size or scope, we make it happen seamlessly.

### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.

## A cleaner future powered by graphitic innovation

Talga develops natural graphite battery anode and advanced graphitic materials that will help shift
the world to a sustainable future.

Our Tier 1 mine in northern Sweden is one of the highest-grade graphite resources in Europe and a
secure source of battery-grade natural graphite. The mine is fully permitted and complemented by our
coated anode production facility (EVA Plant) in Luleå which has been in operation since 2022,
producing anode for customer qualification purposes.

Talga intends to phase up commercial production from the EVA plant to a 5,000 tpa commercial line
before a full-scale 24,500 tpa anode refinery.

## A cleaner future powered by graphitic innovation

Talga develops natural graphite battery anode and advanced graphitic materials that will help shift
the world to a sustainable future.

Our Tier 1 mine in northern Sweden is one of the highest-grade graphite resources in Europe and a
secure source of battery-grade natural graphite. The mine is fully permitted and complemented by our
coated anode production facility (EVA Plant) in Luleå which has been in operation since 2022,
producing anode for customer qualification purposes.

Talga intends to phase up commercial production from the EVA plant to a 5,000 tpa commercial line
before a full-scale 24,500 tpa anode refinery.

anniversary.

[Read more][10]

Charge faster, go further.
Exceed emission targets.
Ensure resilient supply chains.

## Transforming Industrial Byproducts into Next Generation US Made Battery Materials

##### XBM is currently ramping pilot-scale domestic production of next-generation battery Li-Sulfur
##### cathode and Silicon-Carbon (Si-C) anode materials built from abundant U.S. industrial waste
##### byproduct feedstocks. The CarbonX™ Li-S CAM and Si-C AAM platforms are designed to strengthen
##### US supply-chain resilience, increase NextGen battery performance, and help the United States
##### leapfrog legacy battery and chemistry dependencies.



##### See [XBM Whitepaper][17]


## Lithium-Sulfur Cathode Materials Made in the USA.

XBM’s CarbonX Lithium-Sulfur (Li-S) battery materials enable more powerful, lighter, less expensive,
and safer batteries than current EV LIB cathode materials.

CarbonX is made from abundant, industry byproduct  materials (i.e. tannin, lignin, sulfur) that can
be sourced and made in the USA – providing a key critical, domestic, sustainable battery material
supply chain.

XBM wants to be your game-changing battery materials strategic partner. We’ll help you take your
proprietary advanced battery materials and develop the world’s highest capacity, lowest carbon
footprint batteries possible.

## Silicon-Carbon (Si-C) Anode Materials Made in the USA

#### XBM’s high-capacity Si-C (SiCAM) anode platform embeds (TCS) silicon in a primary bonded
#### structure throughout and directly within a graphitized carbon host (CarbonX2) using a scalable
#### FB-CVD process.

###  

#### This patented step-change approach is designed to improve silicon stability while enabling
#### higher anode specific capacity ranges (800-1,200mAh/g), with faster charging times compared to
#### conventional graphite and other Si-C anodes, and is adaptable for use in Dry Battery Electrodes
#### (DBEs).

## Xponential Battery Materials CarbonX Technology will Power the 21st-Century eMobility

Power Tools

XBM’s CarbonX Lithium-Sulfur (Li-S) battery materials enable more powerful, lighter, less expensive,
and safer batteries than current EV LIB cathode materials.

CarbonX is made from abundant, industry byproduct  materials (i.e. tannin, lignin, sulfur) that can
be sourced and made in the USA – providing a key critical, domestic, sustainable battery material
supply chain.

XBM wants to be your game-changing battery materials strategic partner. We’ll help you take your
proprietary advanced battery materials and develop the world’s highest capacity, lowest carbon
footprint batteries possible.

## Silicon-Carbon (Si-C) Anode Materials Made in the USA

#### XBM’s high-capacity Si-C (SiCAM) anode platform embeds (TCS) silicon in a primary bonded
#### structure throughout and directly within a graphitized carbon host (CarbonX2) using a scalable
#### FB-CVD process.

###  

#### This patented step-change approach is designed to improve silicon stability while enabling
#### higher anode specific capacity ranges (800-1,200mAh/g), with faster charging times compared to
#### conventional graphite and other Si-C anodes, and is adaptable for use in Dry Battery Electrodes
#### (DBEs).

## Xponential Battery Materials CarbonX Technology will Power the 21st-Century eMobility

Electric Aviation & Aerospace
